top_signals.summary: Middle East nations have renewed their diplomatic efforts, with high-level delegations from Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan having met with Iranian officials in Tehran on Monday to explore a regional security framework in a bid to de-escalate tensions. top_signals.title: Oil Prices Fall as Vance Moves to Restart Iran Peace Talks
top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices gave up some of the gains they made earlier this week, after U.S. Vice President JD Vance contacted the secretary of the Iranian Supreme National Security Council in a bid to restart peace talks. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $114.14 per barrel, and West Texas Intermediate was trading at $101.45 per barrel, both down from Wednesday but still significantly higher than they were at the start of October.
